records.verificationNote: Pick read directly from the Skeletal Muscle Relaxants table (p.78): baclofen tablets are preferred and carry no asterisk. The PDL states that its clinical PA applies to drugs marked with an asterisk (p.77), so baclofen has no printed PA. Baclofen is labeled mainly for spasticity, not acute musculoskeletal spasm; cyclobenzaprine, the usual acute-spasm choice, is preferred but asterisk-marked, so it is listed as an alternative with PA rather than picked. Strength and sig are standard label dosing. Metaxalone, orphenadrine, chlorzoxazone, carisoprodol and methocarbamol are all named in the class description. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: pick kept as baclofen tablets: the only preferred oral relaxant with no asterisk, so no clinical PA, but it is a spasticity drug. For acute musculoskeletal spasm a prescriber writes cyclobenzaprine (preferred, asterisk = Opiate/Benzodiazepine/Muscle Relaxant clinical PA, p.77-78). If the taxonomy wants the acute-spasm pick, cyclobenzaprine 5-10 mg TID with that PA is the swap; tizanidine (preferred, no PA) is the other no-barrier option. Choice to confirm.]

records.verificationNote: Tier 2, DL and QL 240 per 30 days for tramadol 50 mg read by x-coordinate on page 13. No PA or step on the immediate-release tablet. Judgment: tramadol 50 mg is the lowest-tier short-acting opioid. Combination products (hydrocodone, oxycodone and codeine with acetaminophen) are listed as alternatives because the class definition names them. Tapentadol (NUCYNTA) and codeine sulfate single-agent do not appear in the guide; the guide does not state it is complete, so they are not recorded as excluded. Methadone and the fentanyl and buprenorphine patches are outside this class. Controlled substance, so the limits are recorded in preferredRestriction. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded). Pages, tiers and flags match v17.]
